nodes.name: Record Type Alias Mapping Proposal
nodes.summary: Proposes server-side normalization of cognitive-science memory tier names (Episodic, Semantic, LongTerm, ShortTerm, Working, Reflexive, Perceptual) to canonical Rust enum values. Fixes 400 errors when agents pass cognitive-science terminology to the REST API. No breaking changes — all existing canonical names continue to work. Affects web_server.rs, Python MCP server, and TypeScript SDK.

nodes.name: Record Type Alias Mapping Design
nodes.summary: Details the parse_record_type_alias helper function added to src/web_server.rs, mapping cognitive-science aliases to MemoryType enum values (e.g. Episodic/ShortTerm/Working to Temporal, Semantic/LongTerm to Symbolic). The helper is integrated into handle_add_memory and handle_bulk_add. Alias resolution is input-only; stored and returned values remain canonical.
